no_adcom_quote.quote: The product was not referred for review to an AC because the regulatory path for this imaging indication has been extensively discussed at previous ACs and this application did not raise new regulatory issues.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA204677 (Neuraceq/florbetaben F18). The Summary Review (section 5) states the product was not referred to an AC because the regulatory path for amyloid-imaging agents had been settled at prior committee meetings and this application raised no new regulatory issues, and the Medical Review (section 9) confirms 'No advisory committee meetings are being planned.' The 2008 and 2011 Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee meetings cited in the reviews addressed the amyloid-imaging class and a different agent (Amyvid), not this NDA, so no AC-concern-to-change linkage is attributable to this application's approval.
